customers.evidence: our mission is to deliver great value to our customers every day

shareholders.evidence: we have delivered steady sales and earnings growth and some of the highest returns on investment we have seen in retail

innovation.evidence: We see ourselves as leaders in innovation, constantly testing new ideas

result.analyst_notes: Mostly factual business description with confident, absolute self-claims such as leading, one of the most flexible, and some of the highest returns. First-person plural voice. Customers are addressed first through the mission statement, while growth and returns dominate the rest. Workforce, community and sustainability are absent.
